subject: CAIQ tactical evidence harvest & owner rollup
messages:
From: Evelyn Shaw <evelyn.shaw@fintrust.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: FinTrust Security <security@fintrust.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ — request for compact control bundle and evidence owners

Hi Priya,

We have a CAIQ window for FinTrust's upcoming vendor assessment (audit week starts June 15). To keep the review focused, can Redwood provide: 1) a compact crosswalk (preferred CSV) that maps our requested CAIQ controls to your control owners and artifact pointers, and 2) a prioritized minimal evidence bundle (logs, config screenshots, attestation) we can present to the assessor?

Ideally we'll get the compact bundle by EOD June 10 so we have time to pre-scan. I attached the assessor's CAIQ template (fintrust_caiq.xlsx) with our scope markings — highlighted controls in tab "FT-Scope".

Two asks:
- Can you share your internal owner roster for the highlighted controls?
- Are there any controls that will require a deeper run (longer retention exports, dependency third-party confirmations)?

Thanks — we appreciate the quick turnaround.

Evelyn Shaw
Security Program Manager
FinTrust (vendor risk)
attachments: fintrust_caiq.xlsx
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Shaw <evelyn.shaw@fintrust.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ — request for compact control bundle and evidence owners

Hi Evelyn — thanks for the template and the timeline. We can support a compact harvest and will deliver a prioritized evidence package by June 10 as requested.

Proposed tactical playbook (5-day sweep):
1) Day 0 (today): rapid crosswalk — map highlighted controls to our control registry and assign an owner. Deliverable: control-index.csv (attached).
2) Day 1–3: evidence harvest — owners pull configuration snapshots, screenshots, and log samples. We will aim for minimal artifacts first (1–2 examples per control).
3) Day 4: QA & package — security team does a quick QA pass and produces a zip with an index and narrative notes.

I've attached: harvest_checklist_v1.pdf and control-index.csv. Please confirm owners for the highlighted controls; below is my proposed owner rollup (initial):
- infra logging & retention (controls CCM-LOG-01..03): Ben Carter
- key management, rotation proofs (CCM-KMS-02): Rishi Malhotra
- runtime access controls (CCM-AC-06): Priya Natarajan (I'll coordinate)

If that works I will create a shared Drive folder and kickoff owners with the checklist and upload deadlines (target uploads by 6/09 EOD so we can QA on 6/10).

Counter-dependencies: we may need a 30-day syslog extract for a few controls — flagging now so Ben/Rishi can confirm feasibility.

Sound good?

Best,

Priya Natarajan
Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: harvest_checklist_v1.pdf; control-index.csv
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Evelyn Shaw <evelyn.shaw@fintrust.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ — request for compact control bundle and evidence owners

On Fri, 5 Jun 2027 at 11:22 AM Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com> wrote:
> I've attached: harvest_checklist_v1.pdf and control-index.csv. Please confirm owners for the highlighted controls; below is my proposed owner rollup (initial):
> - infra logging & retention (controls CCM-LOG-01..03): Ben Carter
> - key management, rotation proofs (CCM-KMS-02): Rishi Malhotra
> - runtime access controls (CCM-AC-06): Priya Natarajan

I can own the logging controls. I'll pull a 30-day syslog extract for CCM-LOG-02 and a sample of the real-time ingestion dashboard. Will upload access_log_sample.csv and the dashboard screenshot to the Drive by Tue 6/8 EOD.

Note: for the full retention trace we may need to stitch S3 lifecycle entries across accounts — that's doable but might push beyond the June 10 minimal bundle; I'll prioritize the minimal extractor first.

Ben
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Shaw <evelyn.shaw@fintrust.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ — request for compact control bundle and evidence owners

Ben — I can take KMS rotation artifacts and key policy snapshots. I'll export key rotation logs (last 90 days) and a sample key_policy.json excerpt. I'll also coordinate with infra for the S3 lifecycle note Ben mentioned. Expecting to drop access_log_sample.csv into the shared folder by Tue 6/8.

Rishi
Platform Security Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Evelyn Shaw <evelyn.shaw@fintrust.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ — request for compact control bundle and evidence owners

Thanks all — quick status and next steps: 
- Drive folder created: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1FzAq-example-harvest (read-only link provided to Evelyn/security).
- Expected uploads: access_log_sample.csv (Ben), key_rotation_log.pdf & key_policy.json (Rishi), control-index.csv (Priya).
- QA window: Thu 6/10 morning — I'll pull the artifacts and run the checklist. If anything needs deeper traces we'll flag immediately and provide an ETA.

Evelyn: once we hand you the zip on 6/10 we'll include an index.csv that maps each artifact to the CAIQ control and a 1-paragraph narrative per control describing scope & limitation. If you need the MAP (mutual action plan) formalized in HubSpot I can link the deal (FT-2027-09) and add milestones.

Attachments for FinTrust package (planned): harvest_checklist_v1.pdf; control-index.csv; access_log_sample.csv; key_rotation_log.pdf.

I'll follow up after QA on Thu. Thanks for the fast coordination.

Priya Natarajan
Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
